target_state: not stated in the compilation for this set; the compilation excludes single-crystal targets and states that most specimens were thinned polycrystalline foils or evaporated films (IPPJ-AM-32, p. 2)
original_reference: C. H. Weijsenfeld, Philips Res. Rep. Suppl. No. 2 (1967)
compilation: Matsunami et al., IPPJ-AM-32 (1983); At. Data Nucl. Data Tables 31, 1 (1984)
compilation_table_ref: References for graphs, PDF pp. 281-286 (the figure legend gives the letter)

crosscheck.compilation: Yamamura and Tawara, NIFS-DATA-23 (1995); At. Data Nucl. Data Tables 62, 149 (1996)
crosscheck.agreement: present in Fig. 105 (letter H), but none of its 4 points is separable from neighbouring symbols at 200 ppi; not compared (validation/data/digitize/crosscheck_ar_ni_nifs23.json)
crosscheck.second_read: manual glyph-box centre against the template centre (validation/data/digitize/secondread_ar_ni_am32.json): Y ratio 1.000, E ratio 1.000 at 344 eV (within the digitizing uncertainty), Y ratio 0.998, E ratio 1.004 at 344 eV (within the digitizing uncertainty), Y ratio 1.002, E ratio 0.998 at 788 eV (within the digitizing uncertainty), Y ratio 0.995, E ratio 1.004 at 990 eV (within the digitizing uncertainty)

extraction: Digitized from the 400 ppi scan of PDF p. 103 with validation/data/digitize/matsunami1983_ipp_am32.py: 2-D affine axis calibration from all ~160 tick marks of the log-log frame (residual rms 0.0057 decade in E, 0.0021 in Y); symbols identified by eye from zoomed rasters (listed in the script) and centred by template matching against the figure's legend glyphs, two template sizes; the fitted curve masked out and not stored. Points with 196 eV <= E <= 10.2 keV only; symbols in that range that could not be identified are listed in the script and not stored. Uncertainties are digitizing only (calibration, centring repeatability and the 1.6 % rms scatter of round-energy points), floored at 2 %; the compilation gives no measurement uncertainty. Energy is the total ion energy, yield in atoms per ion (IPPJ-AM-32, p. 6).
reliability_note: Included in the compilation's Ar -> Ni figure, so it passed the compilation's selection (IPPJ-AM-32, pp. 1-2: absolute or normalized-relative yields, room temperature, no dose effects, sufficient beam current; doubtful sets excluded). The compilation does not rank the sets it shows.
terms: Facts, cited; stored under operator decision (#69) despite the compilation's cover note. No figure image and no fitted curve stored.
